models.name: Schedule Completeness TSG
models.description: Provides a standardized, transparent view of linear-channel schedule completeness across current day through 14-day horizons.

objective.heading: Overall Objective
objective.lead: Schedule Completeness (TSG) is intended to provide a standardized, transparent view of how complete and usable linear-channel schedules are by quantifying content that is:

points.label: TBA
points.text: Programming information is not available for scheduled air times.

points.label: Sign-off
points.text: The channel is off-air and not broadcasting during this period.

points.label: Generic
points.text: Channel day is marked generic based on editorial assessment or scheduling patterns.

objective.summary: These conditions are converted into completeness metrics across channels and future airing horizons, enabling users to assess schedule readiness, identify gaps, and monitor improvement over time. The metric represents the percentage of complete content hours - not an error rate - and is calculated using 24-hour cycles across the current day through a 14-day horizon.
objective.note: Calculated using 24-hour cycles (current day through 14-day horizon). The metric represents the percentage of complete content hours — not an error rate.

businessPurpose.heading: Business Purpose
businessPurpose.lead: It serves as a single source of truth for schedule-quality insights. It supports:
points: Daily, weekly, and monthly trend analysis
Identification of scheduling issues and air-time discrepancies
Transparent discussions in client meetings and QBRs
businessPurpose.summary: In short, the objective is to help understand whether schedules are sufficiently populated for upcoming broadcasts, where completeness is weak, and how schedule quality changes as the airing date approaches.

overview.quickTip: 100% means the schedule is complete without TBA content.

models.name: Mapping Stats VOD
models.description: Measures VOD mapping performance, volume, and median turnaround time for assets created since 2019 across entitled catalogs.

objective.heading: Overall Objective
objective.lead: Mapping Stats (VOD) is intended to provide a standardized view of VOD mapping performance across all entitled catalogs. Its core purpose is to measure mapping volume and turnaround time for assets created since 2019, with analysis by mapping status, availability window, create-date range, C2M/turnaround time, and individual assets. It also supports weekly, monthly, and yearly trend analysis.

points.label: Mapped
points.text: Assets successfully matched and available in catalog.

points.label: To Be Mapped
points.text: Assets currently in queue awaiting mapping turnaround.

points.label: Unmappable
points.text: Exception assets requiring investigation and manual resolution.

objective.summary: It provides visibility into approximately 35 million VOD assets, categorized as Mapped, To Be Mapped, or Unmappable, with drill-through to individual assets for backlog and exception investigation.
objective.note: Provides visibility into approximately 35 million VOD assets with drill-through to individual assets for backlog and exception investigation.

businessPurpose.heading: Business Purpose
businessPurpose.lead: It serves as a single source of truth for VOD mapping insights. It supports:
points: Monitor the operational health and efficiency of VOD mapping
Track mapped volumes, mapping percentages, and median turnaround time
Identify backlog spikes, delayed assets, and high levels of unmappable content
Investigate the underlying assets and mapping schemes causing performance issues
Use historical trends to assess consistency and proactively address problems before they become client concerns
businessPurpose.summary: In short, Mapping Stats (VOD) provides transparent, client-specific evidence of how efficiently VOD assets are mapped and made available, supporting operational oversight, client conversations, backlog management, and continuous process improvement.

overview.quickTip: Filter by create-date range to analyze turnaround time bottlenecks.

models.name: CPX Metrics
models.description: Combines operational, service, delivery, and adoption signals into a consistent view of customer health across CPX, helping teams identify risks, prioritize action, and recognize growth opportunities.

objective.heading: Overall Objective
objective.lead: CPX Metrics including Customer Health Score is designed to provide a standardized, data-driven view of customer health across the CPX organization. It brings together operational, service, delivery, and adoption signals—including completeness, response, resolution, engagement, adoption/usage, satisfaction, and NPS—into a consistent view that helps teams understand account health, identify emerging risks, prioritize interventions, and recognize growth opportunities.
objective.summary: The dashboard is intended to move CPX from reactive, fragmented reporting toward a proactive operating model, using a common view of customer health to support regular review, accountability, and action. The Customer Health Score provides the consolidated health perspective, while the underlying metrics retain the detail needed to explain why an account is healthy, at risk, or requires attention.

businessPurpose.heading: Business Purpose
businessPurpose.lead: CPX Metrics including Customer Health Score serves as a shared decision-support layer. Its purpose is to:
points: Establish a single source of truth for customer-health prioritization and provide a consistent view of performance across accounts.

Combine customer-facing and operational signals—such as schedule completeness, VOD asset volume and mapping turnaround, ticket volume, response time, resolution time, engagement, adoption, and satisfaction—so teams can interpret customer health in context.
Enable proactive identification of renewal and churn risk, service-quality issues, adoption gaps, and potential expansion opportunities.
Support client reviews, QBRs, internal prioritization, and targeted action planning by allowing users to move from an overall health signal to the underlying account and metric detail.
Replace manual, spreadsheet-based reporting with a sustainable BI view that is refreshed weekly and available for internal use across the documented CPX Metrics scope of approximately 73 clients.
Help CSMs and internal teams monitor data coverage and delivery KPIs, anticipate issues before clients raise them, and use evidence-based insights in customer conversations.

overview.quickTip: Start with the Customer Health Score, then explore the underlying metrics to understand which accounts need attention.
